description: A tree of nodes that open and close: compact rows like a file explorer, cards joined by lines like a referral network, a top-down org chart, or tick boxes where ticking a parent ticks everything under it. Children can load from your app the first time a node opens, for trees too big to send at once. The arrow keys move through it, as in any tree. Works inside Livewire components, with wire:model for the ticked values.

x-widget.tree.item.details: More about the node under its label, such as a card's figures. Read out as its description.

consider.note: Authorize the node in `children-url`: its id is in the URL, and can be changed to any other.

`children-url` loads a branch only when someone opens it, so the page doesn't send the whole tree. Use `withCount()` to know which children have their own, rather than loading grandchildren, and cap very wide branches.
